seo_title: HEA Case Study: Singapore Energy Engagement | SOMIN
description: For HEA, SOMIN benchmarked Facebook and Instagram engagement for 4 Singapore energy brands and found sustainability led, with 47,849 engagements from 56 posts.
h1: HEA benchmark: sustainability leads, but referral codes skew the numbers
h1_em: but referral codes skew the numbers
lede: For HEA, SOMIN benchmarked the social posts of City Energy, Geneco, SP Group and Senoko and detected the topics and personas behind them. Sustainability led, with 47,849 engagements from 56 posts.
meta_line: A SOMIN engagement study · Jul 2023 to Jun 2024 · Singapore

challenge.title: Normal engagement for 4 Singapore energy brands
challenge.body: Totals mislead when virality or boosting inflates engagement. The study asked where each brand's normal engagement sits, which posts fall outside it and what they are about.

approach.title: Box plots, IQR outliers, comment reads and topic detection
points: Collected likes, comments and shares on each brand's posts.
Plotted each brand's normal engagement range and flagged outliers.
Read comments to explain anomalies such as referral codes and customer-service enquiries.
Detected topics, personas, relevance, tensions and key messages.

findings_title: Referral codes, Geneco's outliers and sustainability's lead

findings.title: Referral codes inflate Senoko
findings.body: Senoko's top Facebook median, 229, comes from a community of referral-code commenters.

findings.title: Geneco puts resources behind its page
findings.body: Geneco had the most Facebook outliers, 35, and the widest range, 219 to 5,797, which usually signals paid reach.

findings.title: Sustainability is the category's topic
findings.body: The top persona, the Sustainable Community Innovator, drew 33,457 engagements across 34 posts.

delivered.title: HEA's benchmark of 4 brands, 3 topics and 4 personas
points: Facebook and Instagram benchmarks: median, IQR, outliers and range
Topics led by Sustainability Initiatives in Singapore's Energy Sector
Personas from Sustainable Community Innovator to Community Impact Advocate
3 relevance themes, 4 tensions and each brand's key propositions

quote.text: It's important to remember that engagement is just a surface-level metric. High engagement doesn’t always mean better brand recognition or higher profits.

outcome.title: HEA should read energy engagement in context
outcome.body: Contests may lift engagement but not the bottom line; an engaged community can be very powerful. For HEA, engagement centres on sustainability, cost-saving and community content.

faq.q: Which brands were benchmarked for HEA?
faq.a: City Energy, Geneco, SP Group and Senoko, on Facebook and Instagram, July 2023 to June 2024.

faq.q: How does SOMIN define normal engagement?
faq.a: Each brand's median and interquartile range (IQR), where about 50% of posts sit; posts beyond 1.5 times the IQR are outliers.

faq.q: Why is Senoko so high on Facebook?
faq.a: Referral-code commenters. On Instagram, without them, its median was 2, the lowest of the 4 brands.
